FINAL FOR PUBLIC:

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT APPLICATION

Applicant: Here to Stay CLT, Inc.
Property Location: 2638 W. Cortland Street
Proposed Zoning: RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 3,125 SF
Here to Stay CLT, Inc. is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 2638 W. Cortland Street from the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit District to the RM-5 Residential
Multi-Unit District. The Applicant requests a re-zoning from the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit District to the
RM-S Residential Multi-Unit District to develop the property with a three-story building containing six
residential dwelling units with no parking spaces. The height of the building will be 31°6”. The subject
property is currently vacant.
NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS
(a) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio:
i, Lot area: 3,125 SF
ii. Total proposed building area: 6,070.5 SF
iii. Proposed FAR: 1.94
(b) Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 520.83
(c) Amount of off-street parking: None
(d) Setbacks:
e Front Setback: 6 FT
e Rear Setback: 13 FT
e Side Setback: 3 ft on each side (6 ft combined)
(e) Building height: 31°6”

(69) Off-street Loading: None
